say:1:1410212001:1.text: Eldric, you've arrived just in time! There's been an issue at the mines today. Some raw materials got delayed, and they're only just arriving now!
say:1:1410212001:1.source_cn: 弗林，你来得正好！今天矿洞那边不知道出了什么问题，原料...

say:2:1410212002:1.text: Everyone's already deep into their tasks, and there's no extra manpower to move these to the smelting workshop. They're waiting on them though.
say:2:1410212002:1.source_cn: 目前人都已经安排开了，根本没有空余人手来运这批，但冶炼...

say:3:1410212003:1.text: What?! That shouldn't have happened... Wait!
say:3:1410212003:1.source_cn: 咦？！不应该啊，矿洞的人怎么会……啊，我知道了！

say:5:1410212004:1.text: Of course, we had that youngster help out with the welcome ceremony earlier. Seems he got a bit too distracted on his end...
say:5:1410212004:1.source_cn: 这真是，今天安排欢迎仪式的时候把老灰给叫过去了，估计是...

say:6:1410212005:1.text: Regardless of the reason, we can't afford any more delays now!
say:6:1410212005:1.source_cn: 不管哪边的岔子，现在的东西可不能耽搁了，弗林！

say:8:1410212006:1.text: When it comes to work, dwarves sure don't hold back. Now that's more like the ones I know!
say:8:1410212006:1.source_cn: 说到干活一点也不客气了，这才是我们熟悉的矮人嘛。

say:10:1410212007:1.text: Chief Eldric, since this problem began due to our visit, why don't we lend a hand?
say:10:1410212007:1.source_cn: 弗林村长，既然事情是因我们而起，不如我们也搭把手？

say:11:1410212008:1.text: I'd also love to see your famed smelting process firsthand.
say:11:1410212008:1.source_cn: 正好，我也想见识见识贵地的冶炼工艺。

say:12:1410212009:1.text: Oh no, no... How could we ask our esteemed envoys to do such menial work? It would be most improper...
say:12:1410212009:1.source_cn: 不行不行……哪能让耀光特使来干这些脏活儿累活儿？多不好...

say:14:1410212010:1.text: Eldric! Enough with your fancy words! The smelting workshop is calling for us again. We're needed!
say:14:1410212010:1.source_cn: 弗林！别客套了！冶炼所那边又又又又在催！

say:15:1410212011:1.text: Uh... I'll get more workers on this right away! We can't let our honored guests dirty their hands—
say:15:1410212011:1.source_cn: 呃……我立刻安排更多人手！一定不能让尊贵的客人参与生产——

say:17:1410212012:1.text: Chief Eldric, there's no need for such formality. Let us help! It can be part of the tour.
say:17:1410212012:1.source_cn: 弗林村长，别客气。就让我们来吧，就当是参观环节的一部分了。
